issues.description: The trusted Entry::new mutable-borrow contract promises that the borrowed PageTableGuard has its original value when the borrow ends, even though the returned Entry exposes that guard through a public mutable node reference.
issues.rationale: Entry::new stores its input mutable reference directly in the public node field. The external-body postcondition *final(node) == *old(node) constrains the eventual referent to remain unchanged, which is not a valid general guarantee for a mutable reference returned to the caller: the caller can replace or mutate the guard through res.node. This false frozen-parent relation is propagated by new_at and PageTableGuard::entry. The direct child fix removes external_body, specifies the initial returned referent separately, and replaces the false final equality with *final(node) == *final(res.node), alongside matching propagation repairs. This is one mutable-borrow root cause; do not also count the earlier path_slot_as_mut repair in4510, which belongs to #545.
